question: Sine bars are used when a high degree of accuracy less than _________ is needed for measuring angles.
solution:
The correct answer is __1 minute.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sine bars__ are precision tools used for measuring angles with high accuracy.
 
• They can measure angles with accuracy less than 1 minute.
 
• They are commonly used in toolrooms and inspection departments.
 
• Sine bars work on the principle of trigonometry by forming a sine angle with a known length.
 
• They are used in conjunction with slip gauges to achieve the desired measurement.
 
• Accuracy depends on the precision of the sine bar and the slip gauges used.
